name: GMM Pfaudler Ltd
about: GMM Pfaudler manufactures corrosion resistant glass-lined equipments  [1]. It is a leading supplier of process equipments to the pharmaceutical and chemical industries  [2]. Over the years GMMP has diversified its product portfolio to include Mixing Systems, Filtration & Drying Equipment, Engineered Systems and Heavy Engineering Equipments.
keyPoints:
Market Leadership
The company is the market leader in the global glass-lined equipment segment, holding a market share of 50% in America, 40% in Europe, 20% in China, and 50% in India. While it faces intense competition in the small vessel segment, the group enjoys a near monopoly in the large vessel segment. [1]

pros: Company's median sales growth is 17.6% of last 10 years
cons: Dividend payout has been low at 9.20% of profits over last 3 years
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -30.9%
